versions.name: Text To Morse
versions.description: A simple mod that converts everything into morse code

about:
# TEXT TO MORSE
Converts every single text ingame into morse code.\
Some text like the difficulty are actually images so they can't be converted.

## IMPORTANT:
To disable it the default keybind is **"CTRL-SHIFT-G"**, it can be changed in the mod settings.\
After you press the keybind you need to refresh the page, by changing menu or refreshing the page (some menus like the level browser have the refresh button), it doesnt refresh automatically.
